title: Stefon Diggs fined for jumping on goalpost after Week 1 TD

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Stefon Diggs fined for jumping on goalpost after Week 1 TD
sources.description: Commanders wide receiver Stefon Diggs punctuated his first touchdown as a member of the team with a celebration that hurt Washington on the field and hurt Diggs in the wallet.
